hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880428 (71 Modern Electric sites list 50-amp; the 14 Full-Hookup sites list 50-amp, water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: 'The 282 campsites are divided into tent or trailer sides of the lake. Tenting only is permitted on the north side.' The booking site lists 124 Modern Non-Electric, 71 Modern Electric, 14 Full-Hookup, 65 tent-only and 5 walk-to sites. Max vehicle lengths mostly 30-40 ft (a few full-hookup sites 45-50); every drive-in RV site is back-in.

sites.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/locust-lake-state-park/stay (count) + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/locust-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880428 (each site's Max Vehicle Length and Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/locust-lake-state-park/stay ('Campground conveniences include modern restrooms and shower houses. booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/locust-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880428 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance') + DCNR park page ('Make online reservations ... or call toll-free 888-PA-PARKS'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer (14 full-hookup sites), 282 sites (max 50 ft, all back-in), showers/dump/camp store; confirmed the inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window. DCNR gives no campground season (park page: 'Contact the Tuscarora State Park office for facility seasons'); booking site shows the campground closed through Apr 1 2027. Not stated: min/max stay, cutoff, fcfs. Fees left at the statewide table.
